name: smwsprites-turn-off-generators
title: Turn Off Generators
description:
This is a disassembly of sprites D2 and D9, the "Turn Off Generators" and "Turn Off Generator 2" sprites. (The extra bit determines which one it acts like.) And yes, I know that the code contained in it is laughably small.
Now SA-1 compatible.
